exposure: husband's employment in the service sector
outcome: adherence to complete postnatal care visits
cohort: The study included 303 mothers of children under two years from five local wards of Phalewas Municipality in Nepal.
finding: Only 40.3% of participants completed all postnatal care visits, with husband's employment, cesarean section delivery, and satisfaction with healthcare services associated with increased adherence, while Janajati ethnicity was associated with lower adherence.
mod_finding: Cesarean section deliveries were associated with increased odds of complete postnatal care adherence.
